text: The Illuminati faked the moon landing. On the actual moon. Plan A was a studio in the desert. Lights. Cameras. A very sweaty astronaut. Then they saw the budget. Building a fake moon cost more than going to the real one. So they flew the whole film crew to the moon, and filmed a fake landing there. The director yelled cut, and the rocket left without them. They're still up there. Waiting for the sequel. Would you go back for them?
